name: Crushed to a 0/6 sand, bound with a hydraulic binder, laid, wetted and rolled (sable stabilisé)

roughness.source: Workings/rolled.stabilised.json: look ('conserve la couleur naturelle du sable et son aspect rustique'): a face of loose-looking grains
roughness.note: No gloss of a stabilised walk was read: a first value for a face of angular grains, as the crushed hardcore's (Shading/Workings/excavated.crushed-stone.json).

roughnessAcross.source: Workings/rolled.stabilised.json: a rolled sand has no direction
roughnessAcross.derivation: a face with no grain: equal to the roughness along

haziness.note: One specular lobe until a goniometric measurement shows a second.

textureDepth.source: Workings/rolled.stabilised.json: the 0/6,3 grading (Bronzo Perasso) of a sand rolled into a crust
textureDepth.note: No texture depth of a stabilised walk was read: a first value, a sixth of the largest grain, for the hollows between rolled grains that hold rain.

relief.source: Workings/rolled.stabilised.json: the 0/6,3 grading (Bronzo Perasso: 'Sable naturel pour sols stabilises 0/6,3')
relief.derivation: half the largest grain, 6.3 mm: the most a grain rolled into the crust stands proud of it
